claims.text: Conditional on the integral \(q^r\)-box Schur basis and integral Pieri rule, for \(p=c=1\), \(q=i+1\), \(r=j+1\), \(d=ij\), and \(0\le k\le b:=\min(i,j)\), the degree-\(d+k\) columns are exactly \[ P_{x,k-x}:=s_{((i+1)^x,i^{\,j-x},\,k-x)},\qquad 0\le x\le k, \] with a zero final part omitted. The requested target is established under these presentation hypotheses.
